verdict.rationale: Kick documents programmatic surfaces aimed at AI-native users: an MCP server with listed tools for querying transactions, generating reports, creating rules and executing bookkeeping changes, connection details for custom AI tools, and a CLI for terminal lookups and reports. However, no general-purpose public API was found: OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and the GitBook llms.txt and ask-query interface only covers the docs, not the product. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/HTTP API with reference docs or an OpenAPI spec, documented auth and rate limits for direct API use, and independent hands-on corroboration that the MCP and CLI surfaces work as described.
